title: One work's defined terms
description: The terms a document's own definitions clause defines, read out of the corpus the work points at. Written by scripts/library-extracts.mjs, which runs the very modules the browser runs (src/lib/library/definitions.ts) so that a bundled work and a work the reader added themselves are read by one grammar. Every term carries a confidence, because this reads a drafting convention rather than a machine-readable field.

unitId.description: The unit that IS the definitions clause, or null where the document has none. Null rather than an absent key: four of the fifteen works genuinely have no such clause, and that is an answer.

marker.description: The clause letter the definition is filed under — "(a)", "(iv)" — or null where the clause carries none.

confidence.description: high: a quoted term under a clause letter. medium: quoted with no letter. low: the quotation marks were lost in extraction and the term was read from the clause letter and the connective alone.

verify.description: True for anything below high — the popover shows a Verify badge rather than hiding the term.
